system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a Helm chart for a stateful application requiring a database migration before pod startup: pre-install hook Job for migrations, StatefulSet for the app, headless Service, and PVC.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Create a Helm chart for a stateful application requiring a database migration before pod startup: pre-install hook Job for migrations, StatefulSet for the app, headless Service, and PVC.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: my-stateful-app
description: A Helm chart for a stateful application with a pre-install migration job
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"

---
# FILE: values.yaml
# Default values for my-stateful-app.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

replicaCount: 3

image:
  repository: my-app-image
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  # Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.
  tag: ""

imagePullSecrets: []
nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

serviceAccount:
  # Specifies whether a service account should be created
  create: true
  # Annotations to add to the service account
  annotations: {}
  # The name of the service account to use.
  # If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template
  name: ""

podSecurityContext:
  fsGroup: 1001

securityContext:
  runAsUser: 1001
  runAsNonRoot: true
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  capabilities:
    drop:
      - ALL

service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 80

# Headless service for the StatefulSet
headlessService:
  port: 80

persistence:
  enabled: true
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  size: 1Gi
  # storageClassName: ""
  # existingClaim: ""

# Database configuration
# It is strongly recommended to use an existing secret
database:
  existingSecret: "" # e.g., "my-app-db-credentials"
  # If not using an existing secret, you can specify the values here.
  # This is not recommended for production.
  # secretValues:
  #   username: "user"
  #   password: "password"
  #   host: "postgres.default.svc.cluster.local"
  #   port: "5432"
  #   name: "appdb"

# Pre-install/pre-upgrade migration job
migration:
  enabled: true
  image:
    repository: my-app-image
    pull
